en.title: aespa Winter Update: Wimbledon Vlog and Japan Dome Tour Official Video
en.summary: aespa's Winter showed her move to London and event preparations in the official video 'See you in London! | WINTER at The Championships, Wimbledon 2026 | Wintering Vlog,' released on August 17, 2026. A Japan Dome Tour behind-the-scenes video released on July 12 captured aespa's rehearsal room and stage preparations.…
